title: EXCLUSIVE: Officina Profumo-Farmaceutica di Santa Maria Novella Names CEO, General Manager
summary: Roberto Pesenti has been appointed CEO of the historic Florentine beauty brand, and will be joined by Marco Barberini in the newly created role of general manager.

brands: Officina Profumo-Farmaceutica di Santa Maria Novella
extraction.key_fact: 피렌체의 역사 있는 뷰티 브랜드가 새 CEO와 총괄 매니저를 임명했다.
